title: LeakSmart Sensor Alert Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=leaksmart:sensor
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sensor_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when LeakSmart sensor alert data has stopped arriving for a given sensor.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per sensor and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your when one part of your LeakSmart sensor alert feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
